==Quest information==
===Requirements===

===Objectives===
* Find Ang the Ephemeral in Panjiang Peninsula.

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
Ang is located near [[Qi Falls]]. To get there, make your way to Tsumei Village. Exit the town heading south west, then west until you get to the spirit.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Professor Gai
''It gives me considerable pleasure to send you on to your next instructor. His name is [[Ang the Ephemeral]], and he is a cherished friend to many of us at the monastery. Believe me when I say that Ang is not what you are expecting, but if you hope to be a great Ritualist, you will heed him well. He awaits you in [[Panjiang Peninsula]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will seek out Ang the Ephemeral.
| decline = I have something I need to do first.
| ask = [[Ang the Ephemeral]] is expecting you in [[Panjiang Peninsula]]. Look for him near the [[Temple of Nai]].
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Ang the Ephemeral
:''I imagine Gai was cryptic, as usual, in his description of me. Did I frighten you? You do not look easily frightened. Well then. let us get started.''
